reasoning:
I reviewed each provided helper to determine if it could assist with changing the title of the CMS page named "Home Page" to "This is the home page!! Leave here!!". Summary: none of the helpers operate on CMS pages or provide mechanisms to navigate to or edit the Magento CMS Page editor; they are all dashboard/orders/customers/export focused. Detailed per-function assessment:

- get_dashboard_summary: Not useful — reads the Admin Dashboard summary and comboboxes; does not edit CMS pages.
- generate_sales_summary_for_date_range: Not useful — changes dashboard date range and snapshots; unrelated to CMS page editing.
- export_dashboard_snapshot: Not useful — exports dashboard snapshot text and can change store/date selections; not for editing CMS content.
- extract_last_orders_csv: Not useful — extracts Last Orders table as CSV; unrelated to CMS pages.
- summarize_top_search_terms_across_store_views: Not useful — parses search-term widgets across store views; not a CMS editor.
- download_revenue_and_orders_report: Not useful — gathers revenue and orders summary and CSV; not for CMS editing.
- get_last_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper to extract last orders CSV; unrelated.
- fetch_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper for last orders CSV; unrelated.
- export_orders_csv: Not useful — exports Last Orders table to CSV, with store/date selection; not relevant.
- save_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — saves recent orders CSV to disk; not helpful for editing CMS pages.
- export_revenue_and_orders: Not useful — high-level revenue/orders export helper; unrelated.
- download_last_orders_summary: Not useful — delegates to export_orders_csv and parses rows; not for CMS.
- download_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — convenience wrapper for orders CSV; unrelated.
- save_last_orders_csv: Not useful — validates and writes Last Orders CSV file; unrelated.
- export_last_orders_csv_simple: Not useful — simple wrapper for Last Orders CSV; unrelated.
- export_last_orders_for_store_and_range: Not useful — wrapper that delegates to other order-export helpers; unrelated.
- export_recent_orders_quick: Not useful — lightweight wrapper for orders CSV; unrelated.
- export_customers_csv_via_grid: Not useful — navigates to Customers grid and triggers grid export; although it navigates to a management grid, it targets the Customers page and export controls, not the CMS Pages editor or editing functionality.

Because none of these helpers provide navigation to the CMS > Pages listing or the ability to open/edit a CMS page's title, none are useful for the requested task of changing the "Home Page" title. To perform the task you would need a helper that navigates to the CMS Pages management path, locates the "Home Page" row, opens the page editor, edits the title input, and saves — none of the supplied functions do that.
